Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: Karmin, warned by the angel, flees with gold and sends his family to Jerusalem while he goes to Babylon, where King Belaon welcomes him and lodges him near the house of an absent merchant (?). The merchant's wife takes Karmin as a lover and bears his child; the king's wife bears a wingless bird-like creature. The two maids, meeting by God's will, swap the infants, and Karmin's son grows up as Nebuchadnezzar, who takes Jerusalem, raises a golden statue, is driven out for his pride and restored, and the kingdom of Babylon stays with his line.

sentences.l: And-then he-arose at-once, and-he-sought gold ʾaskaren (?), and-he-took-it, and-he-woke-her to-his-wife with two his-sons, and-again he-woke his-servants who he-chose, and-he-made-them-carry goods-of glory;
sentences.i: Then he rose at once and sought out gold (?), and took it; he woke his wife and his two sons, and woke again the servants whom he had chosen, and had them carry costly goods;
sentences.n: The subject is Karmin, who has just fled by night on the angel's warning (end of part 1); the verbs are 3rd-masculine-singular perfects with no stated subject. Reading the verbs: ወ- 'and' is prefixed to almost every verb in this narrative (ወኀሠሠ, ወነሥኣ, ወአንቅሃ), so most units open with ወ-; I will not repeat that. ተንሥአ is the tä-stem of ነሥአ ('rise'); ወነሥኣ 'and he took it' carries the object suffix -ኣ (a feminine 'it', gold being treated as feminine). ወርቀ is the accusative of ወርቅ 'gold'. አስከሬን after it is a word I cannot read with confidence (?): it may be a qualifier of the gold or a foreign or corrupt word, so the translation just says 'gold (?)'. (From memory, Amharic አስከሬን means 'corpse'; a Geʿez reading 'the gold of the corpse' is not one I can support (?).) አንቅሃ / አንቅሀ is the causative (ʾa-stem) of ነቅሀ 'be awake', so 'make awake, wake'; ወአንቅሃ (with ሃ, fourth order) is 3ms perfect + the object suffix -ኣ 'her', doubled by ለብእሲቱ, whereas the second አንቅሀ, 'woke again', takes a stated object (አግብርቲሁ) and has no suffix. ለብእሲቱ: the ለ- marks the object and the suffix -ቱ is 'his' (ብእሲት + -ሁ), so 'his wife'. ደቂቁ 'his sons' is the plural ደቂቅ + -u. አጾሮሙ is the causative of ጾረ 'carry a load' (root ṣ-w-r): 'he made them carry'. ንዋየ ክብር is a construct chain 'goods-of glory', i.e. costly, honourable goods. This is the first of many units that end in the clause-marker ፤ (a mid-sentence break) rather than ።.

sentences.l: And-he-went-out by-night, and-he-sent-them, to-his-wife and-to-his-sons, with two his-servants, that-they-enter Jerusalem;
sentences.i: And he went out by night and sent his wife and his sons, with two of his servants, to go into Jerusalem;
sentences.n: ወፈነዎሙ 'and he sent them': ፈነወ 'send' + -ዎሙ 'them'. The people sent are named after the verb with the object-marking ለ- (ለብእሲቱ ወለደቂቁ 'his wife and his sons'), an anticipating pattern: the pronoun suffix on the verb is repeated by a ለ-noun; flagged here, and I will only nudge it later. ይባኡ is the 3rd-plural subjunctive of ቦአ 'enter' (the root b-w-ʾ), so 'that they may enter'; it takes ኢየሩሳሌም directly as a place accusative with no preposition. Jerusalem is the home city of the Israelites in this story; Karmin sends his family there, while he goes the other way to Babylon.

sentences.i: As for him, he went with his two servants to a land far away, a journey of three months, and reached the land of Babylon. He went in to Belaon, king of Babylon, brought him gifts, and told him how he had come to him;
sentences.n: ወውእቱሰ 'and he, for his part': the pronoun ውእቱ + the contrastive enclitic -ሰ, which sets this person against the one just mentioned (the family going to Jerusalem). That enclitic recurs all through this part (ወይእቲሰ, ወነጋዲሁሰ, ወራብዖሙሰ) and is rendered 'as for X'. ሖረ 'he went' (ሖረ, root ḥ-w-r). ርሑቀ ብሔረ 'far, a land': ርሑቅ 'far' is in the accusative as an adverb, then ብሔረ 'a land' (accusative of the goal; it could also be the construct 'land of' with መጠነ ... as its dependent, 'a land of the extent of a three-month journey' (?)); መጠነ 'as far as, to the extent of' is a construct and takes ምሕዋረ 'a journey-of' ፫ አውራኅ. ፫ is the numeral 3 (spoken ሠለስቱ śälästu), and ወርኅ 'month' has the plural አውራኅ. Numerals are kept as written throughout. በላዖን 'Belaon' is the name of the king of Babylon here (Geʿez form kept in l, Belaon in i); ንጉሠ ባቢሎን 'king-of Babylon' is a construct chain. ወአብአ is the causative of ቦአ (ወቦአ 'and he entered' just before), so 'he brought in'; አምኃ 'gifts'. ሎቱ = ለ + -ቱ 'to him'. ዘከመ 'how' (lit. 'that-as'). መጽአ ኀቤሁ: 'he came to him', with the preposition ኀበ + -hu.

sentences.l: And-he-loved-him to-Baʾon to-Karmin, and-he-gave-him lodging in-neighbourhood-of (?) house-of his-merchant;
sentences.i: And Baʾon (apparently the king) loved Karmin and gave him lodging near the house of his merchant (?);
sentences.n: The grammar here is irregular (?). ወአፍቀሮ is 'and he loved him' (አፍቀረ + -ኦ), and both names carry the object/dative ለ-: ለባኦን ለካርሚን. The spellings ባኦን and ካርሚን also differ from በላዖን and ከርሚን elsewhere. I read ባኦን as the king (Belaon, the same Babylonian king) with a loose spelling, and Karmin as the one he loved; the other reading, that Karmin loved Baʾon, is possible given the doubled ለ-. ወወሀቦ 'and he gave him' (ወሀበ + -ኦ). ማኅደረ 'a lodging' (accusative). አግዋረ I cannot identify with certainty (?): I take it as 'neighbourhood, vicinity' (from the idea of 'neighbour'), so 'in the neighbourhood of the house', with ቤተ the construct of ቤት 'house', 'house-of'. ነጋዲሁ is ነጋዲ 'merchant' + -hu 'his': the king's merchant (?), who is introduced here and is away; he becomes the husband in the next units.

sentences.i: As for his merchant, he had gone to a far country for three years; and as for those who had borne false witness, they were killed in the bed in the house.
sentences.n: Two ሰ-contrasts in one sentence (see the note on the third unit). መጠነ ፫ ዓመት 'as much as 3 years', i.e. 'for three years': the numeral ፫ is followed by the singular ዓመት 'year', (unlike ፫ አውራኅ, plural, in the third unit, so the number agreement is loose; the spoken form with the feminine ዓመት would be ሠለስ (?), not the ሠለስቱ of አውራኅ). ሐሰዉ is the 3rd-plural perfect of ሐሰወ 'lie, speak falsely', and ስምዐ is the accusative of ስምዕ 'testimony', so 'they lied a testimony', i.e. 'bore false witness': these are the two false witnesses of part 1. ቀተልዎሙ 'they killed them' (ቀተለ 'kill' + -ዎሙ). The subject of 'they killed' is not stated; presumably the king's men sent after Karmin, who found the witnesses in the house instead (?); the text says only 'in the bed in the house'. ምስካብ 'bed, place of lying down'. This unit ends at ፨, a larger break marker, though the sentence stops short of a full stop.

sentences.i: And the merchant's wife loved Karmin, and went astray with him, and conceived. For the deeds of women are evil.
sentences.n: ወፀንሰትእስመ in the text is two words run together, ወፀንሰት 'and she conceived' (ፀንሰ, 3fs perfect) and እስመ 'for, because'; I have split it. The subject ብእሲተ ነጋዲ 'wife-of merchant' (a construct chain) comes after the verb, as the word order is verb first: ወአፍቀረቶ 'and she loved him' (the suffix -ቶ 'him') is repeated by ለከርሚን, the anticipating-object pattern noted above. ወተስሕተት 'and she erred' is the tä-stem of ሰሕተ; the sense is 'went astray, sinned', here adultery. ቦቱ 'with him' (በ + -ቱ). ምግባሪሆን 'their deeds' (ምግባር + -ሆን, 3fp); ለአንስት 'of/for women' (አንስት, the plural of ብእሲት 'woman'). The last clause is the narrator's own aside, in the general voice of this chronicle's moral comments on women; I render it plainly and do not soften it.

sentences.i: And in the next year she went astray again and conceived by Karmin, for Karmin's appearance was exceedingly handsome among the Israelites.

sentences.i: But she wished, when she had given birth to what she had conceived, to cast it into the sea and to wait for her husband the merchant as one who had not gone astray and had done nothing;

sentences.i: As Solomon the wise said: 'Three things are hard for me in my mind, and the fourth I have been unable to examine: the track of an eagle in the sky, and the way of a beast of the earth upon a rock, and the way of a ship upon the sea;
sentences.n: Allusion: Proverbs 30:18-19, ascribed to Solomon ('Three things are too wonderful for me, four I do not understand: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship on the high seas, and the way of a man with a young woman'). The Geʿez keeps the eagle, the creature on the rock and the ship, and then, in the next unit, replaces the fourth thing with the faithless wife. በከመ ይቤ 'as he said' (በ- + ከመ 'in the way that'; ይቤ 'he said'); ሰሎሞን ጠቢብ 'Solomon the wise'. ፫ 'three' as a numeral. የዐጽበኒ: ዐጸበ 'be hard, be troublesome', 3ms imperfect + -ኒ 'to me'; I read it as 'is hard for me' (?); the Hebrew behind Proverbs 30:18 has 'too wonderful for me', and ዕጹብ 'marvellous' may be from the same root, so 'marvellous' is possible (?). ራብዖሙ 'the fourth of them' (ራብዕ 'fourth' + -ሙ 'them'), with the enclitic -ሰ. ስእንኩ 'I was unable' (1cs perfect of ስእነ); ጠይቆቶ 'to examine it' (infinitive ጠይቆት + -ኦ 'it', as in ወሊዶታ below). አሠረ 'track, trace, footprint' (construct, from አሠር); ፍኖተ 'way-of' (construct of ፍኖት); አርዌ ምድር 'beast-of earth' (አርዌ is 'wild beast' and, I believe, also 'serpent' (?), so the Geʿez may well intend the serpent of the Hebrew; I render the words as they stand); ሐመር 'ship'; በዲበ 'upon'. Geʿez has no quotation marks; I mark the speech with them for English.

sentences.i: And the fourth I have been unable to examine is what he said about the wicked woman who wrongs her husband, and, having washed, sits as one who has done nothing, and swears while she lies.'
sentences.n: ዘይቤ 'that which he said' (ዘ- + ይቤ). በእንተ 'concerning' takes a following word without the construct change here (ብእሲት እኪት 'woman evil'; እኪት is the feminine of እኩይ 'evil'). እንተ 'who' (feminine relative). ትዔምፅ 'she wrongs' (ዐመጸ 'act wrongly, do injustice', 3fs imperfect) + ምታ 'her husband' (ምት 'husband' + -ሃ 'her'). ተኀፂባ 'having washed' (feminine gerund of ተኀፅበ); ጠይቆ 'to examine' is by shape the masculine gerund, used as the complement of ስእንኩ (?). ትነብር 'she sits, dwells'. ወትምሕል 'and she swears' (3fs imperfect; the shape fits a G-stem ምሕለ rather than ማሐለ, but the citation form I cannot fix without Dillmann (?)). እንዘ ትሔሱ 'while she lies' (ሐሰወ, the same verb as the false witnesses above; the form ትሔሱ is read as its imperfect, 3fs (?)). Allusion: Proverbs 30:20, where the adulteress 'eats, wipes her mouth, and says, I have done no wrong'; the Geʿez adapts this to washing. The unit ends at ፨.

sentences.l: And-then wife-of Belaon king-of Babylon she-conceived and-she-bore likeness-of eagle which-not-with-him wing, all-of-him bird perfect;
sentences.i: At that time the wife of Belaon, king of Babylon, conceived and bore the likeness of an eagle, without wings, wholly a bird, complete;
sentences.n: ወአሜሃ 'and at that time' (አሜሃ). ብእሲተ በላዖን ንጉሠ ባቢሎን is a three-link construct chain, 'wife-of Belaon king-of Babylon'. ወለደት is a 3fs perfect with the object አምሳለ ንስር 'likeness-of eagle' (አምሳል 'likeness'). ዘአልቦ ክንፈ: አልቦ means 'there is not to him', so ዘአልቦ is 'which has not / without', and ክንፈ is the accusative of ክንፍ 'wing'. ኵለንታሁ 'all of him, his whole self' (ኵለንታ + -ሁ); ዖፍ 'bird'; ፍጹም 'perfect, complete'. The queen's child, then, was a wingless bird-like creature (?), perfect in body as a bird. The phrase ዘአልቦ appears often; I will gloss it 'without' from here.

sentences.i: She summoned her maid, whom she had chosen, and sent the child in a closed (?) basket, and commanded her to throw it into the sea without anyone knowing.
sentences.n: ወጸውዐታ 'and she called her' (ጸውዐ + -ኣ) with ለአመታ 'her maid' (አመት 'handmaid' + -ሃ 'her', ለ- marking the object). እንተ ኀርየት 'whom she had chosen' (feminine relative እንተ + 3fs perfect of ኀረየ). ወፈነወቶ 'and she sent it' (ፈነወ + -ኦ, written -ቶ after a feminine verb). ምቅላደ is unclear (?): perhaps a word for a closure, lid or lock (from ቀለደ?), so 'a closed/locked basket'. መሶብ is a basket (a woven container, in Ethiopia also a serving basket). ወአዘዘታ 'and she commanded her' (አዘዘ 'command' + -ኣ). ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without one knowing': ዘእንበለ 'without' with the subjunctive, ፩ the numeral 'one' used as 'anyone'. ትገሮ 'she throw it' I take as a short form or slip for ትውግሮ, which appears two units on (ወገረ 'throw, cast stones') (?); the subjunctive after the command means 'that she throw it'.

sentences.l: And-she-also wife-of merchant it-reached her-bearing, and-she-bore child male teacher (?) which good his-appearance;
sentences.i: And the merchant's wife also came to her time, and bore a male child, a 'teacher' (?), fine in appearance;
sentences.n: ወይእቲኒ 'and she too' (ይእቲ + the enclitic -ኒ 'also'). በጽሐ ወሊዶታ: በጽሐ is 3ms 'it reached' (it does not agree with the feminine ብእሲተ ነጋዲ), ወሊዶታ 'her bearing' (the infinitive ወሊዶት + -ኣ 'her', as ጠይቆቶ above is ጠይቆት + -ኦ), so 'her time of delivery arrived' (?); the construction is odd. ወወለደት ሕፃነ ተባዕተ 'and she bore a child, a male' (ተባዕት 'male'). መምሕረ is the accusative of መምሕር 'teacher'; it does not fit the sentence and may be a corruption (?): I give 'a teacher (?)' rather than drop it. ዘሠናይ ላሕዩ 'which good his appearance' = 'fine in appearance', the same phrase as above.

sentences.i: And before she could nurse him, she summoned her maid, whom she had chosen, and sent him in a chest (?), and commanded her to throw him into the sea without anyone knowing;
sentences.n: ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ: ዘእንበለ 'before/without' + the 3fs subjunctive ታጥብዎ, from አጥበወ 'give suck, nurse' + -ኦ 'him' (?); I read the clause as 'before she could nurse him'. The rest repeats the pattern of the earlier maid scene (see the note there): እንተ ኀረየት, ወፈነወቶ, ወአዘዘታ, ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩. ቀማጥረ ሳጥን is unclear (?): ሳጥን is 'chest, box'; ቀማጥረ I cannot identify and render with 'case-of' only as a guess. ትውግሮ 'she throw him' (ወገረ, 3fs subjunctive + -ኦ). Notice how closely the two women's actions are paired in the narrative: each calls the maid she chose, with the same instruction.

sentences.i: In a single night the two women bore their children, and at daybreak they sent their maids to throw their children into the sea.
sentences.n: The verb here, and in several below, is the 3rd-feminine-plural perfect, whose ending is -ኣ (ወለዳ 'they (f.) bore', ፈነዋ 'they (f.) sent'); in the plural masculine it would be -ዉ. So ወለዳ ምስለ ብእሲተ ንጉሥ is 'they bore, with the king's wife', that is the merchant's wife and the king's wife together (this broadens the form's earlier gloss). ወበአፈ ጽባሕ 'and at the mouth of morning' = 'at daybreak' (አፍ 'mouth', construct አፈ). Here ፈነዋ is the 3fp perfect 'they (f.) sent', the two mothers being the subject, and አእማቲሆን 'their maids' (plural of አመት + -ሆን) the object, as in l. ከመ ይውግራሆሙ is 'that they cast them' (3fp subjunctive ይውግራ + -ሆሙ); ለደቂቆን 'their sons' (ለ- marking the object + ደቂቅ + -ሆን 'their (f.)'). ደቂቆን uses the shortened -ን for the feminine possessive.

sentences.n: ወበፈቃደ እግዚኣብሔር 'and by the will of God': በ- + ፈቃድ in the construct state (ፈቃደ), followed by 'God'; the narrator's way of marking providence. ተራከባ 'they (f.) met' (ተራከበ, 3fp perfect; see the ending noted above). ዘእንበለ ይውግራሆሙ 'before they throw them' (ዘእንበለ + subjunctive, as before). ወተናገራ 'and they spoke' (ተናገረ 'converse'); በበይናቲሆን 'among themselves' (?). ወሐተተታ 'and she questioned her' (ሐተተ, 3fs perfect -ት + object suffix -ኣ 'her', doubled by ለአመተ ነጋዲ). አመተ ንጉሥ 'maid-of king' (construct chain), ለአመተ ነጋዲ 'to the maid-of the merchant'. ወትቤላ 'and she said to her' (3fs of ይቤ with the suffix -ላ 'to her'); speakers alternate in the following units, marked each time by ወትቤላ. ምንት ዘውስተ ሣጹንኪ: ምንት 'what?', ዘውስተ 'that (is) in', ሣጹን 'chest' (ሣጹን + -ኪ 'your', feminine addressee). The chest is the container of the merchant's wife's child.

sentences.l: And-he-came and-he-took-her to-Jerusalem by-will-of God, and-he-took-captive-them to-sons-of Israel, and-he-led-them-away to city-of Babylon with sons-of sons-of-him to-Manasseh.
sentences.i: He came and took Jerusalem by the will of God, and took the sons of Israel captive, and led them away to the city of Babylon, with the grandsons of Manasseh.
sentences.n: ወመጽአ 'and he came'. ወነሠታ ለኢየሩሳሌም 'and he seized it, Jerusalem': ነሠተ I take as 'seize, take (a city)' (it may rather mean 'lay bare, demolish') (?), with -ኣ 'it' repeated by ለኢየሩሳሌም, the same object-doubling as before. Allusion: the capture and deportation of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar, 2 Kings 24-25, 2 Chronicles 36; the chronicle presents it as God's will, as the Bible does (e.g. Jeremiah 25). ወፄወዎሙ 'and he took them captive' (ፄወወ, 3ms + -ዎሙ). ወአግዐዞሙ 'and he made them go out, led them off' (the causative of ግዕዘ; sense 'deport' from the context (?)). ሀገረ ባቢሎን 'city-of Babylon' (construct). ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'sons-of Israel' = the Israelites. ምስለ ደቂቀ ደቂቁ ለምናሴ: ደቂቅ is repeated, 'sons-of sons-of-him', and ለምናሴ gives the owner, 'of Manasseh'; so 'with Manasseh's grandsons' (?), the exact relation being loose. The chronicle compresses the history: Manasseh was himself taken to Babylon in 2 Chronicles 33:11.

sentences.l: And-he-became rich exceedingly, until he-set-up statue-of gold in-plain-of Babylon which-of-60 cubit its-height and-6 cubit its-breadth.
sentences.i: He became exceedingly rich, until he set up a golden statue in the plain of Babylon, sixty cubits high and six cubits wide.
sentences.n: Allusion: the golden image of Daniel 3:1, 'whose height was sixty cubits and its breadth six cubits', set up in the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon. ወኮነ 'and he became' (ኮነ, 'be, become'). ባዕለ is the accusative of ባዕል 'owner, rich man', and ጥቀ 'exceedingly', so 'very rich', though the context makes 'powerful' also possible. እስከ ያቀውም 'until he sets up' (እስከ + the 3ms subjunctive of አቀመ). ሐውልተ ወርቅ 'statue-of gold' is a construct chain. In the source ዘ፷ is written as one word: the relative ዘ 'which (is)' fused to the numeral ፷ (60), and ወ፮ is ወ 'and' fused to ፮ (6); both are as printed and I leave them so. Numerals: ፷ is 60 and ፮ is 6; the spoken forms are from memory (?): ስሳ (səssa) for 60 and, for 6, the masculine ስድስቱ (sədsətu) with a feminine ስድስ before the feminine እመት (?), as the house entry for ፫ has ሠለስ (?); the plain reading is 'of sixty cubits'. እመት 'cubit'; ኑኁ 'its height' and ግድሙ 'its breadth' (each a noun + -u 'its'). በሐቅለ ባቢሎን 'in the plain-of Babylon' (ሐቅል 'field, plain').

glossary.ለብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — his wife, i.e. Uriah's (ለ- marking the object + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipated by ለአርዮን)
glossary.ለነጋዲ: ነጋዲ — to the merchant (ለ- 'to, for' + noun)
glossary.ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun) · marking the object, doubled by a suffix on the verb (ይሕምይዎ ለንጉሥ 'they revile the king') or by a suffix on a noun (ሐሚዮቱ ለንጉሥ 'the reviling of the king') · 'of the king', owner after an anticipating suffix (ኅይስናሁ ለንጉሥ 'the worth of the king')
glossary.ለአመተ: አመት — maidservant (noun, fem., construct 'maid of'; ለ- 'to, for')
glossary.ለአመታ: አመት — maidservant, maid (noun, fem.; ለ- marking the object + -ሃ 'her', 3fs)
glossary.ለአንስት: ብእሲት — to women (ለ- + plural አንስት; marks the one obeyed)
glossary.ለከርሚን: ከርሚን — to/of Karmin (ለ- 'to', marking the possessor + proper name)
glossary.ለካርሚን: ከርሚን — Karmin (proper name, variant spelling ካርሚን; ለ- marking the object)
glossary.ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world') · 'for ever' also after ካህኑ: 'his priest for ever', or 'priest of the world' (?)
glossary.ለዘፀንሰቶ: ፀንሰ — conceive (ለ- 'for' + ዘ- 'that which' + 3fs perfect, G + -ኦ 'it', 3ms; 'for what she had conceived')
glossary.ለዝንቱ: ዝንቱ — to this one (ለ- + m. demonstrative) · ለ- marking the object, repeating the suffix on the verb (ለዝንቱ ወሬዛ, ለዝንቱ ሕፃን 'this lad, this child')
glossary.ለደቂቆን: ደቂቅ — sons, children (ለ- marking the object, in apposition to the suffix on ይውግራሆሙ + plural ደቂቅ + -ሆን 'their', 3fp, contracted to -ኦን)
glossary.ለጣዖት: ጣዖት — to idols (ለ- + noun, Greek loan)
glossary.ላዕሌሁ: ላዕለ — upon, over (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form ላዕሌ-)
glossary.ልብ: ልብ — heart (noun; here the genitive in ሐዘነ ልብ 'sorrow of heart')
glossary.ሐመር: ሐመር — ship, boat (noun; ከርሠ ሐመር 'belly of a ship', hold, here of the Ark; uncertain) · a seagoing ship, in the cover story (እመቦ ለእመ ተጐድአት ሐመር 'in case the ship is wrecked')
glossary.ሐሰዉ: ሐሰወ — lie, speak falsely (3mp perfect, G, ḥ-s-w)
glossary.ሐተተታ: ሐተተ — question, inquire of (3fs perfect, G + -ኣ 'her', 3fs)
glossary.ሖረ: ሖረ — he went (3m sg perfect, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.መምሕረ: መምህር — teacher (noun, accusative); here a doubtful reading of the child's description (?)
glossary.መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
glossary.መጠነ: መጠን — measure; መጠነ 'as far as, according to the measure of' (construct as conjunction/preposition)
glossary.መጽአ: መጽአ — he/it came (3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ማኅደረ: ማኅደር — dwelling-place (construct) · accusative 'a lodging' (ወወሀባ ማኅደረ 'and he gave her a lodging')
glossary.ምሕሮ: ምሐረ — have mercy on, pity (3ms perfect, G, m-ḥ-r + -ኦ 'him', 3ms; spelled with 6th-order ሕ, expected ምሐሮ (?))
glossary.ምሕዋረ: ምሕዋር — journey, way (noun; accusative, construct 'a journey of' thirteen days)
glossary.ምስካብ: ምስካብ — bed, couch (noun; from ሰከበ 'lie down')
glossary.ምቅላደ: ምቅላድ — closure or closed container, case (?) (noun, construct 'case of'; sense from context only)
glossary.ምንተኒ: ምንት — anything, nothing with a negative (interrogative pronoun 'what' + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you')
glossary.ሣጹንኪ: ሣጥን — chest, box (noun + -ኪ 'your', 2fs; the text spells ሣጹን with ሣ)
glossary.ረሰየ: ረሰየ — set, appoint, make (3ms perfect, G, r-s-y)
glossary.ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
glossary.ሳጥን: ሣጥን — chest, box (noun; spelled here with ሳ, a variant of ሣጥን)
glossary.ስእንኩ: ስእነ — I was unable (1cs perf., G, s-ʾ-n)
glossary.ቀማጥረ: ቀማጥር — case, container (noun, construct 'case of'; meaning from context only) (?)
glossary.በላዖን: በላዖን — Belaon, the king of Babylon (proper name)
glossary.በሌሊት: ሌሊት — by night (በ- 'in' + noun, fem.; adverbial)
glossary.በሐቅለ: ሐቅል — plain, field (noun, construct 'plain of'; በ- 'in')
glossary.በቢሎን: ባቢሎን — Babylon (proper name, variant spelling በቢሎን, as in ንጉሠ በቢሎን 'king of Babylon')
glossary.በቤተ: ቤት — in the house of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am')
glossary.በአይቴ: አይቴ — by what, in what (በ- + interrogative 'where, what')
glossary.በአግዋረ: አግዋር — neighbourhood, nearness (?) (noun, apparently a plural form; dictionary form uncertain (?); በ- 'in' + construct 'in the neighbourhood of')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በገደ: ገደ — unclear word, perhaps a foreign name-gloss meaning 'bird' (በ- 'in, by' + noun) (?)
glossary.በጽሐ: በጽሐ — he reached, arrived (3ms perfect, G, b-ṣ-ḥ) · with ይእቲ as apparent subject, 'it reached' her bearing, 'her time came' (ወይእቲኒ በጽሐ ወሊዶታ), a 3ms form where 3fs በጽሐት is expected (?)
glossary.በፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — by the will of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct 'will of')
glossary.ባቢሎን: ባቢሎን — Babylon (proper name; ንጉሠ ባቢሎን 'king of Babylon')
glossary.ባዕለ: ባዕል — owner, lord (noun; construct 'owner of') · accusative predicate 'rich' (ወኮነ ባዕለ ጥቀ 'he became exceedingly rich'; 'powerful' is also possible (?))
glossary.ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
glossary.ብሔረ: ብሔር — land, region (construct 'land of') · accusative 'a land' (ርሑቀ ብሔረ 'far, a land'; the construct reading is the alternative (?))
glossary.ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — woman, wife (noun, fem., construct / accusative)
glossary.ብእሴሃ: ብእሲ — man, husband (noun + -ሃ 'her', 3fs; variant spelling of ብእሲሃ)
glossary.ተሐፅን: ሐፀነ — nurse, tend a child (?) (the form ተሐፅን is uncertain: perhaps tä-stem 'is nursed'; person and tense not established (?))
glossary.ተራከባ: ተራከበ — meet, encounter one another (3fp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ተስሕተት: ተስሕተ — go astray, err, sin (3fs perfect, tä-stem) (?)
glossary.ተባዕተ: ተባዕት — male (adjective/noun, accusative; ተባዕተ ውሉደ 'male sons')
glossary.ተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — he arose, rose up (3m sg perfect, n-s-ʾ)
glossary.ተዐውቀ: ዐወቀ — it was/has become known (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ዐወቀ 'know' (?); rendered as a present 'it is known')
glossary.ታጥብዎ: አጥበወ — suckle, nurse (3fs subjunctive, causative አ-, + -ኦ 'him', 3ms; 'she might suckle him') (?)
glossary.ትሔሱ: ሐሰወ — lie, speak falsely (3fs imperfect, G; the form is not checked against a paradigm (?))
glossary.ትነብር: ነበረ — she dwells, sits (3fs imperfect, n-b-r)
glossary.ትውግሮ: ወገረ — throw, cast (3fs subjunctive, G + -ኦ 'it', 3ms; 'she might throw it')
glossary.ትዔምፅ: ዐመፀ — wrong, act unjustly toward (3fs imperfect, G, ʿ-m-ṣ)
glossary.ትገሮ: ወገረ — throw, cast (3fs subjunctive, G, w-g-r + -ኦ 'it', 3ms; ትገሮ for ትውግሮ with ው dropped (?); 'she might throw it')
glossary.ትግድፎ: ገደፈ — throw, cast away (3fs subjunctive, G + -ኦ 'it', 3ms; 'she might cast it')
glossary.ኀርየት: ኀረየ — choose (3fs perfect, G, ḫ-r-y; spelling variant of ኀረየት)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
glossary.ኀደጋ: ኀደገ — leave, abandon (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-d-g + -ኣ 'her', 3fs)
glossary.ነጋዲ: ነጋዲ — merchant, trader (noun; agent noun of ነገደ; plural ነጋድያን)
glossary.ነጋዲሁ: ነጋዲ — merchant (noun, agent noun of ነገደ + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አምሳለ: አምሳል — likeness, image (construct 'likeness of') · accusative 'likenesses, types' after ብዙኀ 'many' (ብዙኀ አምሳለ 'many likenesses')
glossary.አምጻእኪዮ: አምጽአ — bring (2fs perfect, causative አ-, of መጽአ + -ዮ 'him', 3ms)
glossary.አሠረ: አሠር — track, footprint; አሠረ እሙ 'behind his mother' (noun, construct, used as preposition 'after')
glossary.አርአያ: አርአያ — image, likeness · 'vision, appearance' (ዘከመዝ አርአያ ዘርኢከ 'such a vision as you saw', ch. 56)
glossary.አርዌ: አርዌ — wild beast; perhaps also 'serpent' (?) (noun, singular, construct 'beast of'; plural አራዊት)
glossary.አስከሬን: አስከሬን — unclear word after 'gold', perhaps a qualifier of the gold or a foreign or corrupt word (noun?) (?)
glossary.አንቅሀ: አንቅሀ — wake, rouse (3ms perfect, causative አ-, of ነቅሀ 'be awake'; spelled with ሀ, here with a stated object and no suffix)
glossary.አእመረ: አእመረ — know, come to know (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem, not a true causative)
glossary.ኢያልሀቀት: አልሀቀ — bring up, rear (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, causative አ-, of ልህቀ)
glossary.ኣሠርቅ: አሠረቀ — cause to rise (1cs imperfect, causative አ-, of ሠረቀ 'rise, of the sun')
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እሰዶ: ወሰደ — take, carry away (1cs subjunctive, G, with ወ dropped (?), + -ኦ 'him', 3ms; 'that I take him away')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እኪት: እኩይ — evil, wicked (adjective, fem. እኪት; masc. እኩይ)
glossary.እውግሮ: ወገረ — throw, cast (1cs subjunctive, G + -ኦ 'him', 3ms; 'that I throw him')
glossary.እግዚእየ: እግዚእ — my lord (noun + -የ '1cs my') · vocative 'my lord' (ብቊዐኒ እግዚእየ) · in apposition, 'David, my lord' (አቡየ ዳዊት እግዚእየ)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
glossary.ኪያሁ: ኪያሁ — him, it (independent object pronoun, 3ms; base ኪያ- + -ሁ)
glossary.ክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the short form ክልኤ before a noun)
glossary.ኵለንታሁ: ኵለንታ — all of him, his whole self (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወለእሉሰ: እሉ — these, those (plural demonstrative; ወ- 'and' + ለ- introducing the topic + contrastive -ሰ; 'and as for those')
glossary.ወለደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to' marking the object + plural ደቂቅ + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.ወለደት: ወለደ — she bore, gave birth (3fs perfect)
glossary.ወለዳ: ወለደ — he begot her (3ms perfect, G + -ኣ 'her') · 3fp perfect 'they (f) bore' (ወለዳ ምስለ ብእሲተ ንጉሥ 'they bore [on the same night], with the king's wife'; two women)
glossary.ወሊዳ: ወለደ — bear, give birth (feminine gerund, 3fs, G; 'having borne', 'when she had borne')
glossary.ወሊዶታ: ወለደ — bear, give birth (infinitive ወሊዶት, G + -ኣ 'her', 3fs; 'her bearing'; the subject of በጽሐ is unclear, see there) (?)
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወሐተተታ: ሐተተ — question, inquire of (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect, G, ḥ-t-t + -ኣ 'her', 3fs)
glossary.ወመጽአ: መጽአ — and he came (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወሠረዎ: ሠረወ — drive out, expel (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ 'him', 3ms) (?)
glossary.ወራብዖሙሰ: ራብዕ — fourth (ordinal numeral; ወ- 'and' + -ሙ 'of them', 3mp + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
glossary.ወሰመየቶ: ሰመየ — and she named him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወበአሐቲ: አሐዱ — one (numeral; fem. አሐቲ; ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in')
glossary.ወበአፈ: አፍ — and by the mouth of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct አፈ)
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወበካልእ: ካልእ — other, second, next (adjective; ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in')
glossary.ወበጽሐ: በጽሐ — and he reached (ወ- + 3ms perfect, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ወበፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — and by the will of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct 'will of')
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተስሕተት: ተስሕተ — go astray, err, sin (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect, tä-stem; cf. ስሕተት 'error') (?)
glossary.ወተኀፂባ: ተኀፅበ — wash oneself, bathe (ወ- 'and' + 3fs gerund, tä-stem of ኀፅበ; 'having washed')
glossary.ወተናገራ: ተናገረ — speak together, converse (ወ- 'and' + 3fp perfect, tä-stem reciprocal of ነገረ)
glossary.ወተፈሥሐት: ተፈሥሐ — and she rejoiced (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወትምሕል: መሐለ — swear, take an oath (ወ- 'and' + 3fs imperfect, G, m-ḥ-l; citation form not fixed without Dillmann (?))
glossary.ወትቤላ: ብህለ — say (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect ትቤ, defective verb b-h-l + -ላ 'to her', 3fs)
glossary.ወትጽንሖ: ጸንሐ — wait for, await (ወ- 'and' + 3fs subjunctive, G + -ኦ 'him', 3ms, anticipating ለነጋዲ)
glossary.ወኀሠሠ: ኀሠሠ — seek, search for (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, ḫ-ś-ś)
glossary.ወነሠታ: ነሠተ — capture, take (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G + -ኣ 'her', 3fs, doubled by ለኢየሩሳሌም) (?)
glossary.ወነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and he took her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, n-ś-ʾ + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወነገሮ: ነገረ — and he told him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወነጋዲሁሰ: ነጋዲ — merchant (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ሁ 'his', 3ms + contrastive -ሰ; 'and as for his merchant')
glossary.ወአልሀቀት: አልሀቀ — bring up, rear (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect, causative አ-, of ልህቀ 'grow')
glossary.ወአሜሃ: አሜሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወአርአየታ: አርአየ — show (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect, causative አ-, of ርእየ 'see' + -ኣ 'her', 3fs)
glossary.ወአርድእዎ: አርድአ — inform, announce (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, causative አ- + -ኦ 'him', 3ms) (?)
glossary.ወአብአ: አብአ — bring in, present (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative አ-, of ቦአ 'enter')
glossary.ወአንቅሃ: አንቅሀ — wake, rouse (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative አ-, of ነቅሀ 'be awake' + -ኣ 'her', 3fs; doubled by ለብእሲቱ)
glossary.ወአንቲኒ: አንቲ — and you also (ወ- + 2fs independent pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአዘዘታ: አዘዘ — command, order (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect, ʾa-stem, ʾ-z-z + -ኣ 'her', 3fs)
glossary.ወአግብኦ: አግብአ — bring back, restore (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative አ-, of ገብአ 'return' + -ኦ 'him', 3ms)
glossary.ወአግዐዞሙ: አግዐዘ — lead away, deport (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative አ- + -ሙ 'them', 3mp) (?)
glossary.ወአጾሮሙ: አጾረ — make carry, load (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative አ-, of ጾረ 'carry' + -ሙ 'them', 3mp)
glossary.ወአፍቀሮ: አፍቀረ — love, be fond of (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, ʾa-stem, f-ḳ-r + -ኦ 'him', 3ms)
glossary.ወኢገብረት: ገብረ — do, make (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወወሀበት: ወሀበ — and she gave (ወ- + 3fs perfect, w-h-b)
glossary.ወወሀብዎ: ወሀበ — and they gave him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወወሰደት: ወሰደ — take, carry away (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect, G, w-s-d)
glossary.ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — and without (ወ- + preposition) · 'and before' + subjunctive (ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ 'and before she could nurse him')
glossary.ወይእቲሰ: ይእቲ — and she, as for her (ወ- + fem. pronoun + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወይእቲኒ: ይእቲ — and she also (ወ- + 3fs pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወጸውዐታ: ጸውዐ — call, summon (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect, G, ṣ-w-ʿ + -ኣ 'her', 3fs)
glossary.ወፀንሰትእስመ: ፀንሰ — conceive (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect, G, ṣ-n-s) run together with the following እስመ 'for' (two words joined, ወፀንሰት + እስመ)
glossary.ወፍኖተ: ፍኖት — way, path (noun, fem., construct 'way of'; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወ፮: ፮ — 6, spoken ስድስቱ (sədsətu) 'six' (numeral; ወ- 'and'; before feminine እመት perhaps ስድስ (sədsə)) (?)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዓመት: ዓመት — year (noun, fem.; after a numeral)
glossary.ዕቡየ: ዕቡይ — proud, arrogant (adjective, accusative; ኮነ ዕቡየ ልብ 'he became proud of heart')
glossary.ዘለዘርኡ: ዘርእ — seed, offspring (noun + -ሁ 'his', 3ms; ዘ- 'which is' + ለ- 'for')
glossary.ዘመጠነዝ: መጠን — of such size, such a (ዘ- + መጠነ 'measure' + demonstrative -ዝ)
glossary.ዘሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adjective; ዘ- 'which, whose [is]' before the predicate ሠናይ ላሕዩ)
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential) · in whom there is no (ዘ- agrees with ቦቱ 'in him', Christ; ዘአልቦ ቈላፈ 'in whom there is no uncircumcised')
glossary.ዘኢተስሕተት: ተስሕተ — go astray, err (ዘ- 'one who' + ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, tä-stem) (?)
glossary.ዘኢገብረት: ገብረ — do, make (ዘ- 'one who' + ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ዘ፷: ፷ — 60, spoken ስሳ (səssa) 'sixty' (numeral; ዘ- 'which is of', ዘ፷ እመት ኑኁ 'sixty cubits its height') (?)
glossary.የዐጽበኒ: ዐጸበ — be hard, difficult; perhaps also 'be marvellous' (3ms imperfect, G + -ኒ 'me', 1cs; 'is hard for me') (?)
glossary.ያቀውም: አቆመ — set up, erect (3ms subjunctive, causative አ-, of ቆመ 'stand')
glossary.ያእምር: አእመረ — that he may know (3ms subjunctive of አእመረ 'know', a verb with ʾa- prefix, not a true causative)
glossary.ይባኡ: ቦአ — enter, go in (3mp subjunctive, G, b-w-ʾ; 'that they enter')
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይውግራሆሙ: ወገረ — throw, cast (3fp subjunctive, G, w-g-r + -ሆሙ 'them', 3mp; 'that they (f) throw them')
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ጠቢብ: ጠቢብ — wise, a wise man (adjective used as noun)
glossary.ጠይቆ: ጠየቀ — examine, investigate (G; by shape the 3ms gerund, used here as the complement 'to examine') (?)
glossary.ጠይቆቶ: ጠየቀ — examine, investigate (infinitive ጠይቆት, G + -ኦ 'it', 3ms; 'examining it')
glossary.ፅንስት: ፅንስት — pregnant (adjective, fem. sg.; of ፀንሰ 'conceive')
glossary.ፈርሀት: ፈርሀ — fear, be afraid of (3fs perfect, G, f-r-h)
glossary.ፈቀደት: ፈቀደ — she wished, wanted (3fs perfect, f-ḳ-d)
glossary.ፈነዋ: ፈነወ — send (3fp perfect, G + no object stated; 'they (f) sent')
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing')
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine · after a noun, 'third' (ወልድከ ፫ 'your third son'), the spoken ordinal ሣልስ (śalləs) (?)
glossary.፯: ፯ — 7, spoken ሰብዐቱ (säbʿatu) 'seven'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'seven' (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days') · after a feminine noun (ዓመት ፯ 'seven years'), spoken ሰብዐ (säbʿa) (?); placed after its noun it may also be the ordinal 'seventh', ሳብዕ (sabʿ) (?)
